info.name: Membership Inquiry API Tests
info.description:
This collection tests the **backend API** used by the Exclusive Resorts Membership Inquiry form.

It covers positive, negative, security, HTTP method, performance, and response schema scenarios.

**Test coverage:**

- Valid membership inquiry submission
    
- Missing required field
    
- Invalid email format
    
- Consent validation
    
- SQL injection-style input handling
    
- Unsupported HTTP method
    
- Response time and performance
    
- Response schema validation
    

The collection is parameterized using Postman environment variables. The target environment can be switched by updating the `baseUrl` variable.

[Learn more about Postman Collections.](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/collections-overview/)
